text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4819 triggered -> inference_p95 latency spike > 1200ms across us-west-2. Paging eng-oncall. https://pd.example/INC-4819 :rotating_light:

elena: oncall here, looking at traces. p95 is ~1.6s for a handful of customers, not uniform. pulling live flamegraphs now. :eyes:

matt: seeing a big tail when model_cache misses and when sequence_len > 1024. A few tenants sending long prompts in bursts.

olivia: customer-impact? any user-facing errors or just latency?

elena: no 5xxs in SLO window, but interactive UIs are timing out at 2s. Ops reported 3 active PD pages clustered.

alex: starting mitigation: enabling temporary request coalescing + per-tenant rate-limit for heavy tenants. I'll flip the routing to smaller model for overflow.

josh: +1 to model fallback. Can we also enable an alert-coalescing window so PD gets 1 page per incident group? Current noise is multiple PD triggers for same root cause.

elena: doing that now — applying a 90s coalescing window and grouping by fingerprint(customer_id, model_variant, region).

sre-bot: deploy started: alert-coalesce-v1 -> config applied to alerting cluster (ruleset id: ar-7721).

matt: live mitigation notes for the runbook:
```
# temp mitigations applied
- coalesce_window: 90s
- grouping_keys: [customer_id, model_variant, region]
- per_customer_burst_limit: 50 req/min
- fallback_strategy: route->quantized-variant-v2
```

olivia: pushed a quick dashboard to the console: per-tenant latency heatmap + active burst table. Link: https://console.example/dash/te-burst

elena: can we also mute PD escalations for the next 30m while we stabilize? Keep Slack thread updates every 5m.

josh: I'll set a temporary PD suppression rule scoped to the coalesced fingerprint and add an override for any 5xx spikes. suppression id: sup-8921.

alex: traffic falling back toward baseline after fallback routing. Two large tenants throttled by per_customer_burst_limit — they acknowledged and paused heavy background jobs.

matt: collecting post-incident actions:
- formalize alert fingerprinting in alert rules (customer_id + model_variant)
- add circuit-breaker for per-tenant tail latency with automatic fallback to smaller model after 3 consecutive p95 breaches
- add rate-limit metrics to PD payload for stronger dedupe
- new dashboard: per-tenant SLO burn + recent fallback events

elena: creating follow-ups in triage board: TICKET-3177 (alert-fingerprint + coalesce rules), TICKET-3178 (circuit-breaker and auto-fallback), TICKET-3179 (dashboard + docs). Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

sre-bot: TICKET-3177 created and linked to this thread.

olivia: small note for postmortem: include customer communication template and timeline of mitigations. Also recommend a 2-week monitoring window to tune thresholds (p95 vs p99 behavior) before making coalesce permanent.

elena: agreed. Will run a 14-day experiment with the coalesce and per-tenant burst limits applied to 10% of traffic first.

josh: FYI I'll audit existing alert rules tonight for similar noisy patterns and propose a default dedupe config across services.

alex: thanks team. I'll keep fallback routing enabled for another 20m, then gradually roll back if stable. Postmortem draft in #postmortems once we have data. :thumbsup:
